learnings.statement: Author velt-customize probe briefs against the CLONED live DOM, not the wireframe registry. Velt drops the <velt-*-wireframe> registry TAGS when it clones the template into the live DOM; the .vc-* classes and runtime velt-*-internal / .velt-*--* classes survive. Key each block's drive.assert/waitFor/surfaceSelector/liveSelector + element/contract/stability selectors to those surviving runtime selectors, and rebase frameRegion from raw Figma canvas coords to the cropped-frame margin. SYMPTOM: an identical drive.assert / element-not-found failure across ALL blocks means the briefs are mis-keyed, not that the build is wrong.
learnings.evidence: measure-block/verdict-gate were unrunnable until re-key; block6 drove successfully (driven=true, 5 artifacts) the moment drive.assert was swapped to .vc-thread-card. Both Judge and builder independently hit it.

learnings.statement: In @veltdev/react 6.0.0-beta.3, Composer.ActionButton wireframe slots never instantiate (Composer.Avatar/Input do). Deliver composer action buttons via CSS-on-native or treat attach/@mention as mode_blocked.
In @veltdev/react 6.0.0-beta.3, VeltData field filteredCommentAnnotationsCount is empty under embedMode+pageMode, so a page-mode sidebar header count renders no number.
learnings.evidence: live probe of the count tokens; only unreadCommentAnnotationCount populated

learnings.statement: VeltCommentsSidebar dialogVariant routes BOTH the list cards AND the page-mode composer to that variant's wireframe; if the variant has no Composer slot the page-mode composer renders EMPTY. Set a DISTINCT unregistered pageModeComposerVariant to decouple the composer and force Velt's native composer.
learnings.evidence: composer was empty until pageModeComposerVariant='page-native' was added

learnings.note: Composer.ActionButton wireframe does not instantiate in beta.3; force native composer + CSS-theme .velt-composer--input-button
